item.title: New, interesting slabs in the Clarendon tradition?
item.description: I’m looking for a new kind of Clarendon for a project I’m working on. I’ve been using HFJ’s Sentinel for now, but I’m looking with something just a little further removed from the original Clarendon. Any pointers?
